speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have been treated for acute sinusitis and are now experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever. To determine if this is a complication like acute pyelonephritis, have you noticed any burning sensation during urination or changes in your urine, such as blood or cloudiness?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. Based on your history of recent sinusitis treatment followed by persistent fever, fatigue, and flank pain, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of an ascending urinary tract infection that has spread to the kidneys. Have you noticed any nausea, vomiting, or shaking chills recently?
